source: メガトン第 7 居住甲板の改修用。ユーザーが別に生成した 1254x1254 の画像。1 枚の絵のマスは crop で余白 (白い背景や壁) を切り落とす
style: Working neighbourhoods of a space-habitat city: foundry workers dorms, the port and the sailors quarter. Flat, evenly lit, front-on or top-down, no shadows, no readable text.

cells.name: mg-floor-foundry
cells.prompt: Foundry district floor from above: light steel plates with painted yellow walkway lines, scuffs and bolt heads.

cells.name: mg-wall-foundry
cells.prompt: Foundry dorm corridor wall: grey-green painted steel plates with welded seams and stencil-free surfaces.

cells.name: mg-floor-port
cells.prompt: Port warehouse street floor from above: light concrete slab with tyre marks, expansion joints and faint oil stains.

cells.name: mg-wall-port
cells.prompt: Port street wall: light grey painted corrugated steel sheets, vertical ribs, a few dents and rust-free scratches.

cells.name: mg-floor-crew
cells.prompt: Sailors quarter floor from above: old light-brown wooden deck planks, worn and oiled, with metal nail heads.

cells.name: mg-pipe
cells.prompt: Surface of a painted utility pipe: cream paint over steel, a small coloured band and a flange seam, seen front-on and unrolled flat.

cells.name: mg-cable-tray
cells.prompt: Perforated steel cable tray seen from directly above: rows of round holes in galvanised steel with a few bundled cables.

cells.name: mg-shutter
cells.prompt: A closed shop roller shutter seen straight on: light grey corrugated slats filling the whole cell, a little worn at the bottom, no text.

cells.name: mg-bulkhead
cells.prompt: A large pressure bulkhead door seen straight on: heavy steel slab with yellow and black hazard stripes along the edges, latches and a round porthole, no text.
